0.0: By the way, you do know that Maple's Anniversary is #bMay 11#k, right?\r\n#b#L0#Of course I know.#l\n#k
0.1: So, have you prepared a cake? It looks like you're empty-handed.\r\n#b#L0#I didn't prepare anything...#l\n#k
0.2: Hmpf! That's what I figured.\r\nFine, since I, #p9010010#, am as kind as I am beautiful, I'll let it pass if you say the phrase, "Congratulations to MapleStory for reaching its 5th Anniversary," from the bottom of your heart.\r\nWhat do you think?

yes.0: So, you're willing to do it? Great! All it takes is one simple phrase. Rehearse it and see me when you're ready to congratulate MapleStory.

no.0: If you truly love Maple, don't you think you should congratulate the game on its 5th Anniversary? Come back to me if you change your mind.
